summary: Package GPU applications reproducibly while respecting the host driver and the target hardware matrix.
outcomes: Explain which dependencies belong in an image and which remain on the host.
Build a minimal reproducible GPU application image with a capability check.
sequence: Draw host driver, container runtime and application boundaries.
Run a device and library smoke test.
Diagnose a host/container mismatch and document portability limits.

visual.question: Which layer must change to repair this missing or incompatible component?
visual.interaction: Move a dependency to the correct layer and inspect compatibility.

practice.task: Package a verified kernel program and reproduce its smoke test.
practice.success: Image provenance and versions are recorded; unsupported devices receive a useful error.
